description: Minimal stage evaluation fixtures. Each public stage must have one pass-oriented fixture and one blocking fixture so workflow changes remain testable.

given: original request has multiple viable directions
user confirms one recommended direction
expect: 00-intake/brainstorm.md records options, tradeoffs, recommendation, and confirmation
assertions: open high-impact choices are either confirmed or marked NEEDS DECISION

given: direction is still ambiguous
fail.expect_signal: 存在 NEEDS DECISION，且下游产品需求文档 / 需求规格不继续推进

given: verification and wiki_sync gates are approved
release and rollback files exist
expect: 06-close/release.md
06-close/rollback.md
archive dry-run passes
assertions: residual risks have owner and trigger

given: rollback is missing or doctor fails
implementation report, changed-files, and git diff align
expect: 04-code-review/code-review-v1.md has findings-first review and gate recommendation

given: real diff contains an unregistered file
fail.expect_signal: implementation-quality warning or code review finding blocks approval

given: brief is insufficient and current facts need research
expect: 01-spec/research.md has source quality, conclusion, and next route

given: critical external fact has no source
fail.expect_signal: source-quality fails or research remains blocked

given: bug or issue has observable current behavior
expect: 01-spec/gap-report.md records actual, expected, root cause candidate, and regression seed
assertions: tasks can be written without re-diagnosing the issue

given: current behavior is not reproducible and no evidence is recorded
fail.expect_signal: gap report records unobservable status and needs owner / follow-up

given: tasks are approved and implementation is ready
expect: 03-implementation/plan.md
03-implementation/report.md
03-implementation/changed-files.md
assertions: changed files map to tasks and verification notes

given: implementation changes files outside task boundaries
fail.expect_signal: implementation-quality reports unregistered or unexplained diff

given: 简报 / 产品需求文档 / 研究已足够
expect: 01-spec/requirements.md has REQ, AC, NFR, non-goals, and impact flags

given: 验收含义或最小可行版本范围尚未解决
fail.expect_signal: NEEDS DECISION remains and tasks do not proceed

given: discovery workflow needs source-backed conclusion
expect: 01-spec/research.md includes sources, confidence, conclusion, and next step

given: source pool is anecdotal or stale without caveat
requirements / design / tasks are present and traceable
expect: 02-spec-review/spec-review-v1.md has findings-first review and gate evidence
assertions: P0/P1 issues are absent or returned with route

given: tasks do not trace back to requirements or gap report
fail.expect_signal: traceability gap blocks or warns according to workflow policy

given: workspace has zero or one active work item
expect: status, quality suite, decisions, and next route are visible

given: multiple active work items exist
fail.expect_signal: status blocks and asks for work item selection

given: existing codebase needs reusable project memory
expect: 00-steering/codebase-intelligence.md and updated wiki candidates
assertions: graph facts remain evidence candidates until summarized

given: large codebase has no provider and no target module
fail.expect_signal: scan mode / provider decision is required before deep scan

given: source specs are approved or sufficient
expect: 01-spec/tasks.md has waves, Txxx items, trace, files, verification, rollback, and risk
assertions: every source item has implementation and verification coverage

given: a task lacks trace or verification
fail.expect_signal: task quality or traceability warning is emitted

given: requirements and optional UI design are ready
expect: 01-spec/technical-design.md has impact scan, contracts, decisions, risks, and verification strategy
assertions: new dependencies or tooling decisions are confirmed or explicitly delegated

given: new dependency is selected without confirmation or source
fail.expect_signal: technical design blocks on dependency / source-quality decision

given: user-visible behavior requires UI decisions
expect: 01-spec/ui-design.md records page map, state matrix, design language, and Pencil evidence or N/A
assertions: empty, loading, error, permission, and boundary states are covered

given: visual direction is unresolved
fail.expect_signal: UI design pauses for human confirmation instead of inventing style

given: code review is approved
expect: 05-verification/test-cases.md
05-verification/report.md
optional ci-result.md
assertions: evidence strength matches risk and missing evidence is not approved

given: UI flow exists but no Playwright or equivalent browser evidence is recorded
fail.expect_signal: test-case-quality or evidence summary flags the gap

given: work item changed long-lived facts or explicitly has no wiki impact
expect: 06-close/wiki-sync.md and updated wiki or N/A rationale
assertions: temporary logs and process noise are excluded

given: graph fact is marked used_for_wiki but no wiki file references its GF id
fail.expect_signal: wiki-quality warns about missing graph fact reference
